TECH_PARAM_55.TECH_PARAM_DESCRIPTION: ICE information digest: 11 bits information with, from LSB to MSB: bit#1: Transmission flag (the float succeeded to reach the GPS or Iridium satellites), #2: ICE algorithm activated flag (the ICE algorithm is enabled and switched on), #3: ICE surface avoidance flag (the ICE algorithm is able to act on float behavior), #4: Aborted profile flag (the ICE algorithm aborted the ascending profile), #5: ISA flag (the result of ISA check), #6: Breakup period flag (the ascending profile occured during the breakup period), #7: Hanging flag (the ICE algorithm detected a float hanging), #8: Satellite mask flag (the ICE algorithm detected that the float tried but failed to reach the GPS or Iridium satellites constellations), #9: Forced ascent flag (the ascending profile was forced to try to reach the surface), #10: AC1 activated flag (the AC1 (PROVOR_IV float) feature is activated), #11: ICE cycle performed flag (the (Apex APF11) float used at least one ICE cycle after the ascending profile).
